description: The booking app six months after launch. The status report says every measure is on track; its own logs, bills and scripts say a measure has been missed for months, two decisions are due to be reopened, a superseded job still runs, the backups have not been restored since October and nobody but the agent can release.

defects.tell: M2 is 62% in March (131 of 212 bookings without help), against 90% by 2027-01-31; STATUS.md says all measures are on track
D0002 is to be revisited at two or more outages in a month; February had three, and nobody reopened it
calendar_sync.py still runs at 2 a.m. every night, serving D0003, which D0004 superseded and said was removed; its dependency and credentials are still in place
pandas is installed on every deploy and imported nowhere
March cost £11.83 against M3's £5, because SafeBox's free tier ended on 15 January; that is also D0005's revisit condition
make release runs scripts/release.sh, which was renamed to ship.sh in January; the agent calls ship.sh directly, so the documented path for a person has been broken for months without anyone noticing
the monthly restore check was last done on 2026-10-03; five were missed, so nobody knows whether the backups restore

control.tell: M1 holds: zero overlapping bookings in each of the last three months, from the log itself. A report that calls M1 unverified or missed is inventing.
